calculation.description: Ranks assets favorably when their lagged 20-day realized volatility is low relative to its own 60-day volatility history. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed session at decision time. Higher values indicate stable, comparatively calm risk.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across early, middle, and recent thirds; 10-day IC 0.00742, 0.04337, and 0.01040 respectively. Recent 120 dates IC 0.05072. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.gate: absolute daily paper IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR >= 0.0840; passed on same 10-day horizon used for admission
